_meta.what: Every arc-line candidate the record LOGGED as rejected, paired with the two inputs validate_arc_line actually saw at generation time — plus every arc line that has ever actually rendered. NL-105's evidence base and NL-35's first harness piece; the binding acceptance condition of the 2026-08-24 DROP ruling.
_meta.population_bound: NOT 'everything the model ever wrote' (wording corrected by QA fixloop 1, finding #8, 2026-08-24). memory_core._author_arc_line carries rejected candidate TEXT into the warn — and thus into generation_log's state_rewrites detail — only when BOTH attempts fail; its retry-accepted return hands back an empty warn, so an attempt-1 rejected and then rescued by a passing retry is structurally unlogged and cannot appear here. The gap can only conceal candidates the pre-fix validator REJECTED, so every 84-based claim understates the case rather than overstating it.

accepted: thread_state rows WHERE arc_line <> '' — the lines that actually reached a reader.
state_text: thread_state.state_text for the same (thread, edition), ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 — the `clean` state rewrite_state hands _author_arc_line.
